title: Reachability Gives Reflexive Transitive Reachability
statement: Let $K$ be a natural number and $R$ a relation on the natural numbers. If $u$ reaches $v$ at any level under the recursively defined reachability relation—where level $0$ allows equality or one $R$-step and each higher level composes two reachability steps through an intermediate point below $K$—then $v$ is reachable from $u$ by a finite sequence of $R$-steps, allowing a sequence of length zero.
hypotheses_covered: $R$ is a relation on the natural numbers
